correctness.rationale: For a=gamma+1/p in (0,1), decreasing-integrand comparisons yield both Schur supersolution inequalities for u_n=n^-1/p, v_n=n^-1/p′ with sharp C=pi/sin(pi a). Output coordinate truncation gives essential norm <=C limsup|g_k|. Direct algebra verifies k^(1/p)(H_gamma x)_k=sum_n n^-1 kappa_a(log(n/k)) for the logarithmic test vectors. Uniform Riemann-sum convergence, fixed-window slow oscillation at indices attaining limsup, and harmonic masses 2T and 2(T-A) give the reverse lower bound. Weakly null normalized vectors force compact perturbations to vanish. Limits N->infinity, then T->infinity, then A->infinity establish equality; L=0, arbitrary complex phases and parameter endpoints are handled appropriately. Proof inspected in RESULT.md; six Git blobs form the exact assigned tree.
